request.initial_prompt: Pompey. Ah, this thou shouldst have done And not have spoke on 't! In me 'tis villainy; In thee 't had been good service. Thou must know 'Tis not my profit that does lead mine honour; Mine honour it. Repent that e'er thy tongue Hath so betray'd thine act. Being done unknown, I should have found it afterwards well done, But must condemn it now. Desist, and drink.
